change.purpose: Operator request 2026-10-07: 'Spara körkrav sparas inte bestående, värdena återgår till standard om man startar upp Greenfield initialt igen.'

before.runRequirements: Run requirements (Körkrav, the eic.gf.safety.v1 policy) lived only in chrome.storage.local, which belongs to one extension id. An unpacked extension's id is derived from its folder path and every release zip unpacks into a new version-named folder, so loading a release from its own folder started with empty storage and the defaults (24/96/400/800000/24000). Saving itself worked and survived a browser restart in the same folder. Reproduced in Chromium: verification/v191-safety-policy-vault-browser.json, scenario negativeControlBaseline (1.9.0: saved 48/256/1024/3600000/30000 in folder A, folder B showed the defaults).

design.runRequirements: lib/safety-policy-vault.mjs: the policy is also stored in the Chrome profile bookmark store (folder 'EIC Greenfield · Run requirements v1', same staged-write/readback/commit pattern as the v1.2.2 saved-mission and queue-set vaults; a damaged, incomplete or far-future record reads as absent; the newest committed copy by save time wins). updateSafetyPolicy stamps policyUpdatedAtMs/policyOrigin. At startup (once per browser session, kept in chrome.storage.session, 8 s timeout) safetyPolicyVaultPlan picks ADOPT_VAULT / SEED_VAULT / NONE: the newest operator save in the profile wins; 1.9.0 values without a save time count as older than any vault record and seed an empty vault when they differ from the defaults. adoptSafetyPolicyFromVault re-checks inside the journal lock so a concurrent save is never overwritten. A vault failure never blocks startup or the local save; the panel reports it and the next start retries. No manifest key was added (it would change the current id and orphan its storage).

environment.kind: local Node harness with real background.js and mocked Chrome APIs (in-memory chrome.bookmarks = one Chrome profile); Chromium via Playwright with the real installed extension (background + side panel opened as a tab, sender check relaxed in the test copy only) and a real profile bookmark store; panel regression tools with the real panel and a stubbed background

baseline.command: npm test (v1.9.0, git archive of commit 51b4687, re-run for this release)

reproductionBeforeChange.command: tests/v191-safety-policy-vault.test.mjs against the v1.9.0 tree (pure modules copied in, not wired); tools/verify-safety-policy-vault.mjs with GF_BASELINE_ROOT=v1.9.0
reproductionBeforeChange.result: tests 7/16 (only the pure vault/governor tests pass; every background integration test fails); Chromium: 1.9.0 folder B shows the defaults

staleServiceWorkerObserved.note: files copied over the same folder and Chrome restarted: the background still reported APP_VERSION 1.9.0 until chrome://extensions 'Läs in igen'

claimBoundary.liveChrome: Chromium 141 (Playwright build) with the real extension and profile; not the operator's branded Chrome or their profile
claimBoundary.chromeSync: NOT_VERIFIED (bookmark sync between computers; the loader picks the newest committed copy by save time if two meet)
claimBoundary.otherSettings: NOT_CHANGED: Drift basic parameters (eic.gf.operator.settings.v1), processes, queues and usage history stay bound to the extension id
claimBoundary.packageIntegrity: INTEGRITY.json binds packaged bytes; not a code-correctness proof

knownRemainingRisks: Run requirements saved in 1.9.0 in a folder that is no longer loaded are not in the vault; they must be saved once again (or that folder updated in place)
A copy over the same folder needs chrome://extensions 'Läs in igen'; a Chrome restart alone kept the old background (observed in Chromium 141)
Deleting the bookmark folder 'EIC Greenfield · Run requirements v1' removes the durable copy; the next save or start re-creates it from the installation's values
With bookmark sync on, a save on another computer in the same Chrome account becomes the newest save here too
